04 / Power BI workflow

Six stages. One connected workflow.

STAGE 1

Connect

Bring in Excel, databases and cloud sources.

STAGE 2

Prepare

Clean and shape the data in Power Query.

STAGE 3

Model

Relate tables and add measures.

STAGE 4

Visualize

Turn fields into charts and visuals.

STAGE 5

Analyze

Find the patterns and answer questions.

STAGE 6

Share

Publish to the Service for stakeholders.

16 / DAX

DAX turns business questions into calculations.

Measures.dax

      

        
Measure
A calculation evaluated on demand, so it always reflects the current filters.

        
Filter context
The slicers, filters and visual selections that decide which rows a measure sees.

        
VAR & DIVIDE
VAR stores an intermediate result. DIVIDE returns blank instead of an error when dividing by zero.

Where did 6.85 s go?

        

        
DAX query 6,741 msOther 96 msVisual display 14 ms

        
Figures from the screenshot. Almost all the time is the DAX query, and 6,730 ms of that is the DirectQuery round trip to the source. That is the bottleneck to optimise.
